sections.evaluation_comments:
11/4/2026
Closed outside for AM cleaning. Dog approached handler with soft body and wagging tail, took treats. Easy to leash, strong pull to yard, hackles raised and stiff wagging tail when walking past kenneled dogs, no attempts to interact. High energy in yard, jumpy and forceful with handler, remained wiggly with wagging tail, leaned into handler and allowed petting all over, jumpy for treats but sat when given verbal cue, grabby when taking treats, jumped up and nipped arm while handler walked around, did not break skin. Able to pick up leash, strong pull back to kennel, fence fought with kenneled dogs on the way back, tense body, muzzle punching kennel doors, used firm leash pressure to redirect and continue walking. Resisted entering kennel, ignored treats, continued to pull towards neighboring dogs, used firm leash pressure to guide into kennel, dog pushed back out while trying to close door, had to guide dog back into kennel with firm leash pressure, quickly closed door, tried pushing out while removing leash by hand.
10/28/2026
Walk Notes from 10/27/26
As the handler approached the kennel, the canine immediately moved to the front, displaying affiliative behavior through tail wagging and attention-seeking. The canine readily accepted leash placement and walked to the clinic with a moderate pull, remaining engaged with the handler throughout transport. In the clinic, the canine exhibited highly social behavior, frequently moving between both handlers to solicit attention. The canine responded to a verbal sit cue and repeatedly positioned itself in front of a handler to receive petting. When interaction ceased, the canine moved to the second handler and continued seeking social engagement. Following sedation and recovery, the canine remained easy to handle, allowing leash placement without hesitation and walking back to the kennel without issue. The leash was removed safely, and the canine showed no signs of avoidance, resistance, or handling sensitivity during the interaction.
10/18/2026
Dog was closed to back half of kennel, opened kennel divider & verbally coaxed to front half without issues.  Presented leash, would jump up while biting @ leash.  Offered treats, would settle with treats.  Once leashed, would walk with a strong pull on leash while keeping tail flagged & hackles relaxed.  Would pace along fence line in main PY while keeping tail flagged & panting heavy.  Approached handler, jumping up & nipping @ handlers sleeves.  Able to step to the side & direct dog off without issues while scattering treats.  Handler sat on bench, dog would approach handler, leaning in for petting then return to exploring while having tail still flagged & panting heavy.  Tossed toys, was not interested in toys.  Dog would approach handler again, would lean into handlers legs while being pet on head, turned & started to air snap towards hands, not making contact.  Handler picked up leash, dog would start to bite while pulling back on leash, handler dropped leash, dog would start to pace having mouth wide open & tongue hanging out.  Handler called dog over to gate, dog would approach, able to quickly pick up leash & walked back to kennel.  Dog would keep jumping up & biting @ leash, able to keep dog walking to kennel.  Would start to pull back on leash once kennel gate was opened, able to fully step into kennel for dog to follow then step out.  Removed leash by hand without issues.
10/17/2026
Closed outside for AM cleaning. Dog approached handler with soft body and wagging tail, took treats. Easy to leash, hard pull to yard but able to direct when needed, hackles raised and stiff wagging tail when walking past kenneled dogs, no attempts to interact. Affiliative with handler, wiggly body and wagging tail, front paws on lap soliciting attention, allowed petting all over, jumpy when offered treats but sat when given verbal cue, eagerly took from hand. Explored yard, nose to ground, tense with flagged tail when exploring near kenneled dogs on opposite side of fence, returned to handler when verbally coaxed, jumped on bench and lied down next to handler, body soft and wiggly, panting, tongue lolled, allowed more pets, stood on handler's lap and leaned into handler, attempted to lick face. Dog then jumped off bench, followed handler to gate, no issues walking back to kennel. Resisted entering kennel, pulled back and briefly flailed, handler tossed hot dogs in kennel, dog followed, returned to kennel door and allowed handler to remove leash by hand.
10/16/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, standing at gate with soft face and wiggly body language. Accepted treats. Easy to leash. Exited with light pull, appeared interested in neighboring dogs and wagged tail while sniffing towards them. While passing other kennels, dog had raised hackles, appeared more cautious but continued with verbal coaxing. Dog occasionally pulled towards reactive dogs but was easy to redirect with light leash guidance. Dog walked with moderate pull, followed handler into main play yard. In yard, dog explored for a few moments, loose body language, relieved self, then came to handler when called. Dog approached with wiggly body language, a little mouthy on initial approach but settled when gently corrected. Allowed all petting, leaned in. Demonstrated "sit" for treats, took them gently. Dog drank from pool, followed handler around yard. Tried getting into handler's lap, able to be directed back down. After a few more minutes, dog returned to handler on bench, appeared excited, tried getting into lap again, became slightly mouthy towards arms and hands, more difficult to redirect this time. Handler took leash, straight-armed dog away, stood. Dog wagged tail, allowed petting. Moderate pull on return to kennel. Hackles raised, slight tense body while passing neighbors. Dog would not enter outside portion of kennel, began thrashing head, pulling away on leash. No interest in treats tossed inside. Handler walked dog away, was able to lead dog inside kennel wing while other dogs were closed out. Dog would not enter kennel, pulled back. Handler opened divider, led dog back towards kennel. Dog stood and looked outside for a moment, then stepped in. Handler closed gate, removed leash via clip lead. Dog watched handler with soft face, wagging tail. Accepted treats through gate.
10/15/2026
Requesting full evaluation due to activity note.
10/15/2026
Soft wiggly body sitting at front of kennel with tail wagging. Soliciting attentions with handler. Demand barked as handler walked away from kennel.
10/13/2026
Approached ASO with wagging tail and loose bodied, responded well to baby talk becoming more wiggly, allowed easy leashing, walked OK on leash to truck, allowed all handling, could be a bit jumpy and mouthy at times, lifted into truck kennel without issue, very vocal in kennel, settled/calmed with petting eventually laying down then loud barking when door was closed and ASO out of sight.
10/13/2026
walks on leash, hard pull, solicits attention from handlers, allows touch of face and muzzle with ease, leans into handlers for petting, wiggling body, tail wagging to right, mild restraint for vacs, allows all handling / petting on intake, walked to kennel with hard pull, pulls in direction of other dogs, no hackles raised or tail up, resists entering kennel, canine was heavily people forward upon intake

sections.evaluation_comments:
11/1/2026
No issues separating from kennel mate. Pancaked to corner of kennel with eyes wide, trembing body, eyes shifting in all directions, did hesitantly accept treats offered as handler slowly approached. Head shy with leash placement, tolerant of handler petting and carrying to m&g room, allowed all handling with tense body. In m&g room dog was very timid throughout, tail tightly tucked, wary of surroundings and handler, took a few moments before dog began pacing around slowly with head lowered, hunched over body. Would eat treats tossed near but stayed arms length away from handler, tolerant of petting but did not seek out attentions, flinches when startled or attempts to hide head underneath chair. No issues carrying back to kennel, placed into kennel and removed leash by hand with no issues.
10/31/2026
Curled up with kennelmate on approach, tense, head low. Would not come forward for treats or coaxing. Handler opened gate, dogs stood quickly, kennelmate retreated outside, handler closed divider. Dog curled up in back corner, stoic, avoiding eye contact. Slowly ate chicken left nearby. Handler approached, was able to gently pet, then pick up and carry out to play yard with kennelmate and second handler. In yard, dog paced surroundings with kennelmate, tail tucked, nervous and easily startled. Eventually curled up in corner of yard with kennelmate. Pulled away from attempts to pet, slowly began eating treats tossed onto grass, then accepted a few by hand. Remained nervous and tense, avoided handlers. After a few more minutes, second handler picked up kennelmate. Handler approached this dog slowly, crouched, was able to gently pet dog along head and neck, then lifted dog without issue, carried back to kennel and removed leash by hand.
10/29/2026
Requesting a full evaluation based on intake notes.

shut down, tense. allowed handling and restraint for vaccines. does not walk on leash, carried to kennel.

11/6/2026
Patient initially wagging tail and playful at front of kennel. Upon kennel entry for exam, patient continued wagging tail, did retreat to back of kennel, no reaction to approach and full exam performed with no restraint. Wagged tail when spoken to.
10/31/2026
Dog was closed inside for cleaning. Displayed soft face on approach, wagging tail, but retreated away as handler got closer. Handler opened kennel, dog retreated to kuranda bed, laid flat, tense body. Ate treats left nearby. Handler used large loop to place leash; dog flinched hard on leash contact, thrashed head, then settled. Would not exit kennel. Handler stepped in, crouched, spoke softly. Dog would not come forward. Handler was able to secure muzzle wrap, then dog thrashed head hard, bolted out of kennel. Pulled towards other dogs with wagging tail, would lean against kennel gates. Handler tried guiding dog away, dog began thrashing body and twisting around on leash. Pawed at leash, leapt up into the air. Handler was unable to guide dog into taxi, used verbal coaxing and light leash pressure to guide dog towards door. Once outside, dog continued to thrash and jump on leash. Handler used straight-arm, approached dog and spoke softly. Dog settled, wagged tail, flinched back when handler attempted to pet. Handler was able to quickly apply muzzle wrap, then lift and carry dog to small yard. In yard, dog was wary of handler and surroundings, maintained distance. Hard flinched, jumped back at any sudden noises, or when handler reached out. Dog would cautiously take treats from hand, avoided any touch. Dog would occasionally soften, appear to play-bow towards handler, then would become evasive again, running from handler with tail tucked. Handler was able to retrieve leash, dog pulled back, thrashed head. Handler slowly guided dog into corner of yard, crouched beside, able to apply muzzle wrap and place dog into taxi. Dog rode well, paws on edge. Tense when touched but tolerated petting. Dog softened, wagged tail when passing other dogs, appeared interested. Tolerated more petting while near other dogs. Dog jumped out of taxi into kennel, retreated onto bed. Handler stepped in, able to slowly remove leash by hand.
10/30/2026
Dog was standing outside, ears perked, tail wagging, panting, stared at handler, unable to coax inside verbally or with treats, closed divider and met dog outside. Dog was standing at kennel door, soft body and wagging tail, took treats. Backed away when presented with leash, handler kneeled down and tried coaxing forward verbally and with treats but dog would not approach again, retreated and pancaked against back wall, able to step in and place leash, dog would not exit kennel, pressed body against divider, allowed handler to approach and pet, licked hand, able to pick up and place in taxi, attempted to jump out initially but settled quickly and rode well to small yard, sat up and observed surroundings. Dog exited taxi, explored yard, nose to ground, neutral body, easily startled, ate treats tossed around yard, did not seek attention from handler, avoidant as handler walked around yard, handler kneeled down and tried coaxing dog over verbally and with treats, would not approach, sat in corner of yard, shifted weight further into corner as handler approached, ears pinned, lip licking, gave tail wags as handler pet, able to pick up and place in taxi, restless on the way to kennel, able to pick up and place in kennel, able to step in and remove leash by hand.
10/29/2026
Came to front of kennel with soft wiggly body & sat. Requesting full eval based on field notes.

appeared playful but hesitant for touch. Vocal on truck, tolerates most handling but doesnt solicit.

Dog was relaxed body on approach to kennel.  Once gate was opened, handler was able to leash dog, dog would attempt to jump out of kennel, able to quickly pick up. Approached handler, placing front paws onto handlers knees, allowing petting.  Would attempt to jump up onto chair next to handler, unable to fully jump up.  Handler would pick up dog, dog would start to growl while jumping out of handlers hands & onto chair.  Would sit beside handler while allowing petting, slowly walked onto handlers lap, handler would offer treats, would take treats.  Went to pet dog again, dog would start to growl then jumped off from handlers lap.  Dog would return to handler, allowed more petting then started to growl again while walking away from handler. Placed a towel over dog to pick up, dog would growl while thrashing body while attempting to pick up.  Handler removed towel & walked dog to new kennel room.  Opened kennel gate & tapped on bottom of kennel, dog would sniff edge of kennel, would not jump up.  Handler knelt down & placed towel back over dog, dog would thrash while growling & biting a towel, removed towel & waited for dog to settle. Handler approached kennel front with towel prepared for transport. On approach dog was halfway on bed nose "glued" to back corner of shoreline. sections.evaluation_comments:
11/3/2026
Outside for AM cleaning laying flat on ground in middle of kennel, stoic, whale eye, no interest in treats or coaxing. Dog slowly got up with slow loose tail wag when leash was presented, came forward to eat treats tossed near but wary of leash and quickly retreated to back of kennel, hiding head in divider pocket, flinching heavily when touched with leash, would pancake and rest head along wall so leash could not be secured, offered dog treats and able to slowly place leash. Froze in place, would not walk on leash, positioned taxi at front of kennel and dog entered taxi on own, rode fine to small play yard, touch sensitive but tolerated petting on head. In yard dog slowly crawled out of taxi, tail tucked, did not venture far from taxi and pancaked underneath nearby chair, stoic, little eye contact with handler, would only eat treats tossed near and did accept treats gently but would not move from original spot, did not follow treat trail. Touch sensitive when petted, skin crawled heavily when first touched but does settle and became more tolerant of petting on head/body, scanning environment slowly throughout. Let dog have a few moments, remained pancaked when picking up leash, positioned taxi in front of dog and dog walked into taxi on own. No issues with return, exited taxi into kennel slowly, very subtle/slow attempt to dash out of kennel but settled when door was closed, able to remove leash by hand with no issues.
11/2/2026
Dog was standing in back half of kennel on approach, slowly came forward for treats to front half of kennel.  Presented leash, dog would start to walk back towards kennel divider, slowly closed divider.  Dog would turn around & face handler while tossing more treats into kennel.  Would dodge leash placement, able to secure leash after a couple attempts while dog would have ears flattened, licking lips & keeping head lowered.  Walked out of kennel with verbal coaxing then would stand still bodied in front of behavior taxi.  Tossed treats into behavior taxi, dog would follow treat trail.  Rode to small PY without issues.  Would explore with nose to ground.  Would not come towards handler when called or for treats.  Would become still bodied while keeping head lowered each time handler would approach dog.  Tolerated petting without reaction.  Repositioned behavior taxi then tossed treats inside, dog would slowly walk back into behavior taxi.  Rode well back to kennel.  Exited into kennel with treats to coax.  Would start to pull back on leash as handler would extend hand to remove leash.  Handler would drop a jackpot amount of treats @ front of kennel to coax forward again then removed leash by hand while dog would be eating treats.
10/30/2026
Requesting full eval based on intake and previous notes.
10/28/2026
Approached ASO first took food, allowed for a slow leashing, did NOT walk on leash, thrashed and bit at leash but settled when pressure was released, was able to muzzle wrap and load into truck kennel without issue.
10/28/2026
ACO went out to truck and attempted to place K9 into small bucket, K9 jumped out and pancaked onto sally port, ACO muzzle wrapped K9 and picked up and carried onto ramp, vaccines were given with muzzle wrap and minimal restraint, K9 was picked up and placed into deeper bucket,second leash was placed to help K9 stay in bucket, taxied to kennel, K9 was picked up and placed into kennel, allowed for leash removal.
10/28/2026
Dog needed to be moved due to guillotine not working. When handler approached kennel, dog engaged with handler by looking at handler with soft eyes while laying on ground. Handler was able to leash dog with no issues and was able to coax dog out of kennel with no problems. Once out of kennel, dog froze and sat down. After some gentle coaxing, dog was able to walk out of building on leash with no issues. Once outside, dog stopped and pancaked on to ground. Handler tugged on leash gently which got the dog to stand up on all fours. When handler tugged again on leash to move forward, dog started thrashing on leash. Handler stopped to let dog settle down and then tried to move dog again after a few moments. Dog again thrashed on leash and started lip licking. Handler called for assistance and when assistant arrived, handler instructed assistant to close in all guillotines so other dogs in kennel building were not present while trying to move dog closer to outside kennel. Once all dogs were secured inside, handler tried to walk dog to kennel once more when dog began to thrash on leash again. Handler then called for additional assistance. While waiting for more assistance, first assistant started to present treats and create a treat trail for dog. Dog was not interested in treat trail. When additional assistance came, they asked for a bucket to place dog into. First handlers leash was on dog but was under dogs front legs resulting in 2nd handler needing to place their leash on dog. Once the second leash was secured on dog, original handler dropped leash and 2nd handler took over. Second handler was able to get dog into bucket by lifting dog with leash into bucket. When dog was in bucket, handler moved dog into kennel and dog got out of bucket with no issues. Handler then was able to remove both leashes while the dog was in kennel. Dog's body was stiff, had wide but soft eyes with little whites, and dog lip licked throughout the entirety of the movement however no other FAS behaviors were present.
